source_access_note: Records without public links are not treated as missing. TRACE distinguishes EMA request pathways, IMA Library request pathways, reference-only records and public online access.
knowledge_base_maintenance: The master list is generated from the canonical data/*.json source files. TRACE v8.0 retains the v7.3 application structure and v6.12 visual language while expanding source coverage, discovery relationships, media story organisation and optional spatial layers.
preview_note: Spatial Discovery uses the locally stored Trinidad and Tobago ADM1 GeoJSON as the canonical browser boundary asset. Media, AAQMN and IMA layers are off by default; only one IMA Marine Data Hub layer is selected at a time.
news_note: EMA in the News contains 701 public story parents linked to 785 selectable article records and 963 source options. Media coverage is a discovery aid and is not an EMA determination of environmental severity, status or causation.
international_scope_note: The strict international_reference collection remains restricted to Trinidad and Tobago-specific submissions, country/site/project records or country datasets. Additional development-partner and government material is held in explicitly attributed external collections.
video_note: The searchable video database includes verified official and relevant Trinidad and Tobago-specific records. Refresh tools add candidates/metadata without introducing AI search.
deduplication_note: The same intellectual document is not duplicated solely because it appears in multiple repositories; alternate source or host links should be attached to the primary record where practical.
use_note: Descriptions, classifications, map associations, media categories and related-record suggestions support information discovery only and do not provide legal advice, legal interpretation, compliance status or an EMA determination.
